meta.doc: Machine-readable notes on the public cluster web API surface used/probed by this tool.
meta.policy: public, unauthenticated endpoints by default; the opt-in --guest-entry mode reproduces the normal client guest flow only (single world, no enumeration); a handful of probes; no endpoint enumeration/bruteforce; no DRM/key work
meta.secretPolicy: API-key/token value classes documented in prose only; no key literals in this repository

hosts.telemetry: cl4r.net (client-side analytics; unused by this tool)

notes: Non-secret build identifiers reproduced from the public web client; overridable per run.

No Authorization header by default. The opt-in --guest-entry mode sends 'Authorization: Bearer <anonymous-guest idToken>' obtained from the public identitytoolkit sign-up below; tokens stay in memory for the run.
Plain product token without parentheses (HTTP client comment-splitting caveat).
404 with id envelope when world id is unknown/not publicly accessible.
Unknown/unmodeled response fields are preserved by WorldMetadata.Extra.

endpoints.auth: public web API key in URL (client-shipped project identifier; never vendored in this repo)
endpoints.status: evidence-backed (client constant FirebaseAuthenticator.GoogleSignUpUrl + AnonymousSignInParams); exercised only by --guest-entry
notes: Exactly what a fresh, free client install performs as an anonymous guest sign-in; no account login.
Credential stays in memory for the run; error bodies are masked before display.

endpoints.auth: Authorization: Bearer <anonymous-guest idToken>, empty JSON body {}
endpoints.status: verified live (October 2026): HTTP 201 UserPrivateResponse {userId, isAnonymous:true, ...} — links the Firebase identity to a fresh anonymous cluster account; exercised only by --guest-entry
notes: Required BEFORE any room route: without it every room route answers 401 BAD_TOKEN_EXIST (live-verified).
The response userId travels as the X-Cluster-LoginID header on subsequent room routes (missing => 400 BAD_REQUEST_ROOM_ENTER 'room entry request not exist').
Matches ApiUserRepository.LoginAsync -> RimuldarApiClient.LoginAsync in the IL2CPP dump.

endpoints.status: evidence-backed (route literals /v1/world_room_set/ + /entry_request, CreateEntryRequestResponse {deepLink, roomId}); exercised only by --guest-entry
notes: Same authorization context as account.guestLogin: Bearer idToken + X-Cluster-LoginID header + X-Cluster-Device/-Platform 'Win' (room routes gate on platform: 406 platform_not_supported outside Android/Oculus/NowGG/iOS/Mac/Win).
Returns HTTP 201; the runtime roomId from this response is what /v1/rooms/{roomId}/enter_v2 expects (not the venueId; observed as a reused world-server GUID).

endpoints.auth: Firebase Authorization header + X-Cluster-LoginID + X-Cluster-Device/-Platform 'Win' (platform-consistent with the entry request)
endpoints.status: verified: GET probe -> 405 method_not_allowed (POST-only); live guest chain verified October 2026 (entry_request -> enter_v2 -> RoomEnterResponse); exercised only by --guest-entry with the entry-request roomId
notes: Client payload shape PostEnterV2RoomPayload { metricsPayload: string }; this tool sends a self-identifying string instead of device metrics and retries once with an empty string on HTTP 400.

Returns HTTP 201 RoomEnterResponse; embeds venue (RoomVenue) incl. platformResources manifest: {assets:[{id, assetBundleUrl}], mainScene:{assetBundleUrl, assetIdsDependsOn, unitySceneName}, subScenes:[...]}.
Without --guest-entry this tool stops at the no-auth boundary; see docs/RESEARCH.md sections 3 and 8.
Deep-link fetch used before entering; same trust level as enter_v2.

endpoints.status: verified: 404 UNREGISTERED_ROOM for a room GUID (rooms are runtime sessions)
verified: 405 (PATCH-only management space); also 405 for a world GUID id class

clientDeliveryChain.summary: Venue bundle manifest (RoomVenue.platformResources with UnityAsset/UnityResource assetBundleUrl entries) is delivered via the guest-authenticated room-enter flow; the explicit opt-in --guest-entry mode reproduces the normal client guest chain for one specified world.
clientDeliveryChain.http: UnityWebRequest against absolute assetBundleUrl values from the manifest (no Authorization header on bundle GETs)
clientDeliveryChain.caveat: Some venue assets pass through AesAssetDecryptor (IAssetDecryptor) after download; raw bytes of such entries stay encrypted — this tool never decrypts anything.
clientDeliveryChain.boundaryDecision: Default (no flags): resolver reports DeliveryStatus.NotImplemented (exit code 2) at the no-auth boundary. Opt-in --guest-entry: documented guest-flow equivalence (anonymous Firebase sign-up -> world_room_set entry_request -> rooms enter_v2 -> platformResources), exit code 5 with a masked reason when cluster refuses.
